units: SI, absolute pressure, water loading per active dry MOF
release_control: M24 freeze; later versioned corrections preserve original prospective results
fields: One separately prepared synthesis, not a sampled time point
Independent material/assembly block A B or C
Feed composition; distinct from measured product
Dry and wet bases never mixed
Measured state p/T recorded; not unlabelled normal flow
Source evaporation/regeneration, useful, rejected and leak estimates
Pump valve vapour mover compressor electronics and fixture separately
Candidate bed/wall temperatures, loadings, vapour/liquid inventories and any qualified internal state
All candidate model classes predict common measurements, including structure where qualified
Heat allocation, timing, vapour conductance and branch pressure assistance
Equipment maps and permitted domain confirmed before deployment
Exact executable version and tuning manifest
Same permitted exogenous information for all controllers
Command, realised action, interlock cause and recovery
Whole history/block split; no random point split

handoffs.months: M3 provisional; M9, M18 and M24 releases
handoffs.contract: Sample and synthesis-batch IDs; feed/measured composition and phase; activation; kg water/kg dry MOF; p in Pa absolute; T in K; loading-dependent J/mol-water enthalpy; dynamic histories; ageing and uncertainty.
handoffs.acceptance: IKTS accepts mass/processability; UPorto accepts identifiable constitutive/observation fields; Savery checks the cycle window.

handoffs.months: M4 interface; M10 coupons; M18 windows; M24 as-built
handoffs.contract: Forming-lot/cartridge IDs; binder and MOF mass fractions; dimensions in m; active/shaped/substrate masses separately; conductivity W/(m K), permeability m2, contact resistance m2 K/W; mechanical properties and covariance.
handoffs.acceptance: Savery accepts mechanical/thermal/vapour fit; UPorto accepts parameter provenance and variance.

handoffs.months: M2 boundary; M4 virtual rig; M8 measured; M16/M22 updates
handoffs.contract: Topology and control-volume IDs; SI boundary histories; calibrated sensor transfer functions; actuator realised limits/delay; bypass state; W and J by heat/electric channel; liquid and adsorbed inventories.
handoffs.acceptance: UPorto verifies closure and observable quantities; HPE checks executable I/O, timing and fallback authority.

handoffs.months: M4 simulator; M10 model; M22 ROM; M24 freeze; M34 assessment
handoffs.contract: State/action/observation definitions; model and estimator hashes; calibrated/earned domain; uncertainty and observation mappings; timestep, solver hardware and 99th-percentile timing.
handoffs.acceptance: HPE runs contract and real-time tests; Savery tests declared observability and boundary reconstruction.

handoffs.months: M12 baselines; M24 qualified policies; M34 comparison
handoffs.contract: Policy and tuning-data manifests; forecasts/constraints; safety-filter/fallback version; HIL outcomes; deployment timing; commanded/realised actions, overrides and reward/cost logs.
handoffs.acceptance: Savery accepts actuator and interlock compatibility; UPorto checks common estimator and prospective split.

prospective_holdout: Group C, complete C09-C12 waveforms and endpoint responses are not fitting data. Routine QC is permitted under frozen rules. Final waveform draws remain sealed until the M24 manifest.
